references.text: Jesus also mentions the fate of Tyre and Sidon in comparison with the fate of the cities that reject his disciples.
Jesus condemns the cities of Chorazin and Bethsaida for their unbelief and compares their fate to that of Tyre and Sidon.
The prophet Ezekiel speaks of God's judgment on Sidon, which can be seen as a parallel to Jesus' words about the city's fate.
